text: 22分、ウェストポート・アルビオンのラファエル・デラクルワが約4メートルの距離からゴールを決めました。キアン・カスティーヨによるボール奪取から始まり、7回のパスをつなぐ約26秒の攻撃で生まれたチャンスです[#401][#398][#391]。これでスコアはキングスムーアFC 2、ウェストポート・アルビオン 1となり、アルビオンが追いかける展開の中で意地の得点を挙げました。縦パスを多用しながら中央突破を狙ったチーム戦術が効果を発揮しています[#396][#399]。

- From this turnover, Westport Albion built a patient, structured attack lasting over 25 seconds and involving 7 passes, predominantly short and progressive, indicating their tactical style of direct, vertical passing aimed at quick penetration through the lines [#391-#398].
- The involvement pattern, with multiple short passes from Castillo linking repeatedly with teammates before a final key pass by Castillo to Rafael Delacroix, exemplifies Westport’s utilization of a 4-4-2 formation optimized for vertical connectivity and progressive entries into the final third, rather than wide usage [#396, #398].
- The goal resulted from a close-range shot from Delacroix after a successful carry forward, demonstrating effective transition from midfield regain to an overload in central areas that overcame Kingsmoor FC’s wide, crossing-based 4-4-2 defensive shape [#398, #399, #401].
- Kingsmoor FC’s style centered on wide play and crossing likely left central channels more vulnerable, which Westport’s direct, vertical passing exploited to unlock their defense and reduce Kingsmoor’s ability to press effectively (evidenced by Westport’s favorable field tilt and possession in the last 10 minutes) [team styles; last 10 minutes].
